suite_requirement: schema_version 1; full physical schema INT only; positive exact_rows; every supplied arm_order must contain all SIX arms exactly once. Old five-arm order must be explicitly re-registered.
invocation: PYTHON -B -I -S runtime_fair_v4/supervisor.py --runtime-lock ABS_READY_V4_LOCK --suite ABS_REGISTERED_SIX_ARM_SUITE --out-dir NEW_UNDER_TODAY --kind cost|differential --job-start 0 --job-limit 6

canonical_sql.admission: common raw frontend guard; actual original SQL parse; both queries recognized by v4 kernel
canonical_sql.rewrite: recursively sort only AND operand lists by stable JSON AST; no simplification, expression rewriting, IC inference, movement, commutative arithmetic rewrite or COUNT elimination
canonical_sql.decision: identical resulting full AST => unsat by pure SQL three-valued conjunction commutativity; otherwise complete official fallback
canonical_sql.failure: FrontendUnsupported never falls back; parse/recognize/normalization failure is retained and takes same-budget official fallback
canonical_sql.cost: fresh process + full Environment/schema/IC + common contract checks + parse/recognize/normalize timings + fallback + cleanup; no pair-equivalence oracle pre-run

sat_oracle.common_gate: kernel.sqlite_integer_domain_audit for every original query; all must be SAFE_FOR_SQLITE_INT64 before SQLite original SQL replay
sat_oracle.post_replay_checks: single scalar row; only exact Python int or None; compare independently executed SQL result with concrete mathematical diagnostic; then check q1/q2 inequality or query-differential output correspondence
sat_oracle.out_of_domain: UNKNOWN_ORACLE_DOMAIN remains a non-success outcome with complete witness and denominator; no replay success, speedup win or algorithm counterexample
sat_oracle.error: audit/input/replay/type/shape/value mismatch errors retained; no data clipping, float tolerance, schema/IC weakening or hard-example removal
sat_oracle.fallback_outside_auditor: official SAT for a query outside the reviewed expression auditor becomes UNKNOWN_ORACLE_DOMAIN rather than trusting an unproved integer replay domain
sat_oracle.timing: all domain/replay work included in shared process CPU/wall envelope and semantic E2E; candidate may reuse its existing plan, official/differential audit parses original SQL

semantics_reporting.implementation_evidence: runtime wrapper and actual run method identity plus locked-source AST constructor inventory (comments excluded)
semantics_reporting.verieql_v1_auto: BagSemanticsVerifier for unordered queries, ListSemanticsVerifier when both ordered
semantics_reporting.spotit_auto: SetSemanticsVerifier in both branches; never reported as bag
semantics_reporting.boundary: local dispatched verifier instance is not instrumented; scalar one-live-row agreement between set and bag is a property of this fragment, not implementation evidence
semantics_reporting.sqlite: Counter comparison of complete SQL output rows is independently labeled; does not change engine semantics

denominator: all registered jobs prewritten NOT_RUN; retain unknown, frontend unsupported, fallback, errors, budget stops and nonselected remainder
execution: None by this agent; parent registers source/suite lock and controls unique actual run
